description: This file defines a SimplePagerAdapter class that extends FragmentStateAdapter to manage a list of Fragments for a ViewPager2 in an Android application. It binds fragments to the ViewPager2 based on position.

classes.name: SimplePagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter that binds a list of Fragments to a ViewPager2, allowing swipe navigation between fragments.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of fragments managed by the adapter.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns the fragment for the given position.
